title: msswift: pickle-loads @ swift/dataset/indexed_dataset.py:129

root_cause.note: IndexedDataset.__getitem__ deserialises every record with pickle.loads(buffer) straight from the packed data-*.bin shards. Whoever can write the shard files (shared dataset cache, poisoned packing pipeline) executes code on the first __getitem__ during training. Reproduced at function level: upstream __init__ builds the index, upstream __getitem__ unpickles the attacker slice and the marker is written before any downstream use.

preconditions: attacker can write the swift packing cache dir (PACKING_CACHE or dataset cache)
a training job opens the packed IndexedDataset
steps: load the verbatim pinned v4.6.0 indexed_dataset.py with the swift/modelscope tree stubbed
plant a malicious data.idx (and data-00000.bin slice) under evidence/
call the real upstream __init__/__getitem__ and observe the marker inside pickle
expected_evidence: marker written by the pickle payload inside the upstream sink
run.json with source sha256 and stub manifest
cleanup: temporary files under evidence/ are rewritten on every run
